scope: Two pre-registered volatile official documentation URLs for CDC pipeline architecture and embedding quantization; no source discovery was performed.

verified_claims: Debezium documents multiple deployment forms for its source connectors, including Kafka Connect, Debezium Server and an embeddable Debezium Engine.
The Debezium Server architecture streams serialized change events from a source database to messaging infrastructures such as Kinesis, Pub/Sub or Pulsar.
The architecture guide distinguishes connector-based change capture from the transport and application embedding choices downstream of the source connector.
records.boundary: The documented deployment options do not guarantee event ordering, delivery semantics, index idempotency or end-to-end recovery. Those properties depend on the connector, transport, sink and application design.

verified_claims: Sentence Transformers documents binary and scalar int8 embedding quantization as ways to reduce representation size for retrieval.
Its scalar-quantization guide maps float32 values to discrete int8 levels using a calibration dataset whose min/max ranges define buckets.

The binary-quantization guide describes retrieving an expanded candidate set and optionally rescoring with float32 query embeddings; the examples present memory, disk and speed trade-offs rather than a universal quality guarantee.
records.boundary: Quantization behavior and example trade-offs are library documentation. Calibration distribution, rescore multiplier, model, index and hardware determine actual recall, latency and storage results and require local regression evaluation.
